'''Eduardo Sáenz de Cabezón Irigaray''' (born 24 June 1972, [[Logroño]]) is a Spanish mathematician, and professor of [[computer language]]s and systems at the [[University of La Rioja]] since 2001. He is a recognized specialist in scientific [[monologue]]s. He develops his research in the area of [[Computer algebra|computational algebra]], to which he has contributed 25 research publications and collaborations with Spanish and European mathematicians such as [[Henry Wynn|Henry P. Wynn]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://zbmath.org/authors/?q=ai:saenz-de-cabezon.eduardo|title=zbMATH – the first resource for mathematics|website=zbmath.org|access-date=13 January 2019}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://documat.unirioja.es/servlet/autor?codigo=1802425|title=Eduardo Sáenz de Cabezón Irigaray|website=Documat|language=es|access-date=13 January 2019}}</ref>

Cabezón is also known for disseminating mathematics through conferences, shows and talks for people of all ages around the world. He was the winner of competition for scientific monologues at [[Famelab]] Spain (2013) and at the Aquae Foundation (2014), also becoming a finalist at the [[Cheltenham Science Festival]] (United Kingdom).<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.bigvanciencia.com/somos-big-van|title=Quiénes Somos|website=bigvanciencia.com|language=es|access-date=13 January 2019}}</ref>

== Career ==
Eduardo Sáenz de Cabezón studied during his youth at the Sagasta Institute in [[Logroño]]. After high school, he decided to study mathematics and computer science, inspired by a teacher passionate about mathematics.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://matematicos.matem.unam.mx/matematicos-r-z/matematicos-s/eduardo-saenz-de-cabezon/1448-eduardo-saenz-de-cabezon-si-soy-nerd-y-estoy-orgulloso-de-eso|title=Eduardo Sáenz de Cabezón: "Sí, soy nerd y estoy orgulloso de eso"|website=matematicos.matem.unam.mx|access-date=13 January 2019}}</ref> He was also licensed in theology at the [[Comillas Pontifical University|Pontifical University of Comillas]], and holds a PhD in mathematics from the [[University of La Rioja]].<ref>[https://belenus.unirioja.es/~esaenz-d/files/cv-english.pdf Curriculum Vitae Eduardo Saenz-de-Cabez] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110727172253/https://belenus.unirioja.es/~esaenz-d/files/cv-english.pdf |date=July 27, 2011 }}</ref>

=== Doctoral thesis ===
Cabezón obtained his PhD with the thesis "Combinatorial Koszul homology: computations and applications" for which he obtained the grade of outstanding [[Latin honors|cum laude]] unanimously of the court.<ref>{{Cite arXiv|title=Combinatorial Koszul Homology: Computations and Applications|last=Saenz de Cabezon|first=Eduardo|year=2008|eprint=0803.0421|class=math.AC}}</ref> His thesis is framed within the area of [[Computer algebra|computational algebra]]. In it, the [[Homology (mathematics)|homology]] of [[Jean-Louis Koszul|Koszul]] for monomial ideals is studied. In the thesis, Cabezón described the structure of this type of ideals based on his Koszul homology, described [[algorithm]]s for the calculation of this homology, and implemented algorithms that show to be effective.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.unirioja.es/apnoticias/servlet/Noticias?codnot=1047&accion=detnot|title=Eduardo Sáenz de Cabezón, doctor con una tesis sobre álgebra computacional|website=unirioja.es}}</ref>

== Popular science ==
[[File:Eduardo_Fame_Lab.jpg|alt=|thumb|280x280px|Eduardo Sáenz de Cabezón at Famelab 2013.]]
Cabezón is known for his career in [[popular science]] and mathematics. He has been telling stories in bars and cafes for 22 years, but has branched out to host and participate in a variety of mathematics communication events:

=== Events and conferences ===
* He is a member and founder of a group of active [[scientist]]s and researchers called ''Big Van Science'' since 2013, dedicated to scientific dissemination with the aim of bringing [[scientific communication]] to all types of audiences. He is also the author of the mathematical show ''"El baúl de Pitágoras"'', which was shown in theaters and bars in several cities in Spain since 2012.
* He has participated with the [[TED (conference)|TED]] organization doing conferences and lectures on the mathematical world.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Eduardo Sáenz de Cabezón |url=https://www.tedxriodelaplata.org/orador/eduardo-s%C3%A1enz-cabez%C3%B3n |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190402231549/https://www.tedxriodelaplata.org/orador/eduardo-s%25C3%25A1enz-cabez%25C3%25B3n |archive-date=April 2, 2019 |access-date=April 2, 2019 |website=TEDx Riodela Plata}}</ref>

=== TV ===
* He is presenter of the Spanish late night show of science and humor ''[[Órbita Laika]]''.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.elperiodico.com/es/yotele/20190128/orbita-laika-vuelve-novedades-matematico-presentador-7272534|title='Órbita Laika' vuelve a TVE con un matemático como presentador y más novedades|last=Yotele|first=Redacción|date=January 28, 2019|website=elperiodico|language=es|access-date=2 April 2019}}</ref>

=== Internet ===
* He currently has the YouTube channel called ''Derivando'', in which he teaches and explains curiosities about the mathematical world, with more than 1.3 million subscribers.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.unirioja.es/premiado-el-canal-derivando-de-eduardo-saenz-de-cabezon/|language=es|title=Premiado el canal Derivando de Eduardo Sáenz de Cabezón|trans-title=Derivando channel by Eduardo Sáenz de Cabezón awarded|work=News|publisher=Universidad de la Rioja|date=26 April 2022|access-date=2024-04-10}}</ref>

=== Books ===
* He is the author of the book ''Inteligencia matemática'' which attempts to popularize mathematical concepts by comparing them to examples in everyday life. Eduardo argues that they are an opportunity to enjoy reality because: "''whether we want it or not, we all have a mathematician in our interior, who maybe got scared at school and remains hidden in a corner"''.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.unirioja.es/apnoticias/servlet/Noticias?codnot=4367&accion=detnot|title=Eduardo Sáenz de Cabezón publica Inteligencia Matemática|website=unirioja.es}}</ref>
* He is also co-author of the book ''Gardner para aficionados: Juegos de matemática recreativa''.
